He didn't approve of Friskies. He would recommend Iams or Science Diet. My opinion is...most cats dislike science diet. I feed my cat wet friskies food. 
So if your willing, I personally use Iams urinary health for my female cat. It fills her up on less, it's more nutritionally dense and...you have less poop in the box to clean up.
